items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Bill Harris was on one side and I was on the other side.

ctx.x: Had to be in the 30's because we were in the studio and that's when they were having these all-star records. Bill Harris was on one side and I was on the other side. Sy Oliver made an arrangement and Duke made one side. Sy wouldn't give him no solo. Duke said, 'Uh-huh...' That's when we made the first side.
What was the name of it?
